scalability_plan.plan: Single node; vertical scaling; replicated app behind a load balancer.
Small cluster; Redis sharding; read replicas for analytics.
Regional deployments; partition data stores by governorate.
Multi-region federation; tenant-aware routing; event mesh.

refactoring_strategy: Always preserve behavioral compatibility; refactor behind interfaces.
One measured extraction at a time; never speculative service splits.
Keep dormant modules mergeable into national releases.
Enforce module boundaries with review gates, not process isolation.
Eliminate circular dependencies before adding new abstractions.

milestones.title: Clinical safety certification
milestones.scope: ISO 15189, CAP, CLSI evidence packs automated and continuously validated by the quality gates.
milestones.migration: Additive compliance reports; existing data untouched

milestones.title: National pilot readiness
milestones.scope: Operationalize the national pilot: identity platform, FHIR R4 contracts, offline sync hardening, multi-tenant isolation proof.
milestones.risk: Scope creep across governorate pilot sites
milestones.technology: Python 3.12, FastAPI, PostgreSQL 16, Redis — unchanged stack
milestones.migration: Feature-flag pilot rollout; no data migration

milestones.title: Observability at national scale
milestones.scope: OpenTelemetry tracing, structured logs, and metrics across every surface; incident runbooks rehearsed.

milestones.title: Analyzer integration network
milestones.scope: ASTM/HL7 device bridge standardization across laboratory hardware, with validation and audit of every result.
milestones.migration: Adapter per protocol; no core schema change

milestones.title: Governorate rollout
milestones.scope: Multi-directorate deployment with Ministry hierarchy, regional data residency, and national event bus federation.
milestones.risk: Data residency and latency across governorates
milestones.migration: Tenant-aware data routing with backward-compatible reads

milestones.title: National identity federation
milestones.scope: Citizen identity authority federated with national health platform; ABAC authorization at Ministry level.
milestones.migration: Claims-based identity mapping with rollback adapter

milestones.title: Federated event mesh
milestones.scope: Fault-tolerant, self-hosted event mesh connecting every governorate deployment into one logical platform.
milestones.technology: Federated event bus with durable queues
milestones.migration: Gradual federation; local queues remain authoritative

milestones.title: National EHR interoperability
milestones.scope: Full FHIR R4 national EHR exchange; SNDHS government integration; cross-governorate continuity of care.
milestones.migration: Canonical FHIR resource migration with dual-write window

milestones.title: National intelligence platform
milestones.scope: Aggregated analytics and clinical intelligence across the national platform with strict privacy preservation.
milestones.migration: Read-model projections; source of truth unchanged
